item.description: Panic gripped BBC Pada in Bhawanipatna town of Odisha’s Kalahandi district after a firing incident was reported near the Hanuman Temple under Town Police Station limits late Tuesday night. item.title: Mother’s love knows no bounds: Stray dog fetching 'rotis' for puppies melts the internet, watch
item.description: Parents- especially mothers- can go to unimaginable lengths to ensure the safety, comfort, and happiness of their children. From sleepless nights to silent sacrifices, their love is instinctive and unwavering. And this devotion is not limited to humans. The animal kingdom offers some of the purest examples of motherhood- raw, unfiltered, and deeply moving. A recent viral video proves exactly that, reminding viewers that a mother’s heart beats the same, regardless of species. Must Read: Guardian

item.title: Six Odia workers stranded in Thailand allege non-payment of wages; seek State government’s help
item.description: Six migrant workers from Odisha have reportedly been stranded in Thailand, alleging non-payment of wages, threats from their employer, and acute food shortages. The workers have appealed to the Odisha Government to intervene and facilitate their safe return to India. The six youths, hailing from the Rajkanika area of Kendrapara district and the Chandbali region of Bhadrak district, had travelled to Thailand in August last year after being promised employment at a plywood manufacturing company.
